items: Files are validated on import: layouts[0] must contain nodes, edges and stations arrays, otherwise the adjustment is aborted.
Import reports nodes/edges without vehicleType properties, which would abort the adjustment.
Import checks, per vehicle type, how many nodes, edges and stations (via their interaction nodes) use it and warns about gaps.
Import warns about stations that are not mapped to existing nodes.
Profiles can only be selected after a file was imported without errors.
Transformation options can only be changed with the CUSTOM profile; all other profiles are locked.
